name: clipboard-copy
description: Bash-based MCP server providing cross-platform clipboard tools — clipboard_copy for inline text and clipboard_copy_file for the contents of a file at an absolute path. Auto-detects the right backend per environment (pbcopy on macOS, wl-copy/xclip/xsel on Linux, clip.exe on WSL, clip on Cygwin/MSYS) and falls back to OSC 52 escape sequences when no native utility is available. A PreToolUse hook blocks native clipboard-write commands in Bash and routes them to the MCP tools.
